en.headline: Tutorial centre owner jailed for six years and four months over assaults on five boys
en.dek: The High Court sentenced Yu Hey-tsit after he admitted 15 counts of indecent assault and four counts of making child pornography committed at a Mei Foo centre between 2017 and 2023.
body: The High Court on Tuesday sentenced the former owner of a private tutorial centre in Mei Foo Sun Chuen to six years and four months in prison after he admitted indecent assaults on five boys and making child pornography.

Yu Hey-tsit, 46, pleaded guilty earlier to 15 counts of indecent assault and four counts of making child pornography. The offences took place at the Prime Solid Learning Education Centre between September 2017 and August 2023, when the victims were aged between seven and 14.

Mr Justice Douglas Yau Tak-hong described the acts as despicable and repulsive, saying they constituted a serious breach of trust. The judge noted that a deterrent sentence was required to reflect society’s abhorrence of such offences and to deter others.
The case came to light in August 2023 after one of the boys spoke to a relative. Yu was arrested the following day and later admitted the offences. The centre has since closed.

zh.headline: 美孚補習社負責人非禮五男童判囚六年四個月
zh.dek: 高等法院星期二判處余希哲監禁六年四個月，被告早前承認15項非禮及4項製作兒童色情物品罪，案涉五名年齡介乎7至14歲男童。
body: 高等法院星期二判處一名前美孚新邨私人補習社負責人監禁六年四個月。被告余希哲（46歲）早前承認15項非禮罪及4項製作兒童色情物品罪。
案情指，被告於2017年9月至2023年8月期間，在美孚新邨「Prime Solid Learning Education Centre」內非禮五名男童，事主當時年齡介乎7至14歲。
法官游德康形容被告行為卑鄙及令人厭惡，嚴重違反誠信，判刑必須具阻嚇性，以反映社會對此類罪行的厭惡，並阻嚇其他人。
案件於2023年8月由其中一名男童向親屬透露後揭發，被告翌日被捕並承認控罪。涉案補習社其後已結業。
